title: BDD/TDD: harden browser isolation against service-worker routing escape
description: Capability: safe rendered/stealth audits. BDD: Given a target that attempts service-worker controlled fetches or DNS rebinding, when rendered or stealth engine runs, then browser traffic remains pinned through the secure proxy and private/loopback destinations are blocked. TDD: add failing browser-pool/zendriver tests for service-worker-disabled context, proxy use, DNS rebinding fixtures, and context-release behavior before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Rendered/stealth engines disable or neutralize service-worker routing escapes; regression tests cover browser DNS rebinding and private-address blocking.
notes: TDD RED: node --test --test-name-pattern BrowserPool disables service workers tests/browser-pool.test.js failed because --disable-service-workers was absent. GREEN: added Chromium launch flag and verified focused test plus tsc build pass. Full browser-pool suite still needs loopback-bind capable environment for existing proxy tests.

title: BDD/TDD: make pnpm quality gate non-interactive
description: Capability: reliable validation runner. BDD: Given a clean checkout with dependencies installed, when an agent runs pnpm run quality:check in a non-interactive shell, then typecheck, unit, MCP contract, and coverage gates complete without hanging and return a deterministic exit code. TDD: first reproduce the wrapper hang with a failing smoke or script-level test, then fix shell/package-manager behavior and verify pnpm run build, pnpm run test:unit:ci, pnpm run test:mcp:contract, and COVERAGE_MODE=ci pnpm run coverage:check.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run quality:check completes in non-interactive shells; direct-command fallback is no longer required; coverage thresholds still pass.
notes: TDD partial: package script regression test added and passes; .npmrc pins /bin/sh and disables package-manager version management; package scripts reduce nested pnpm for quality coverage/typecheck. Live lean-ctx-required pnpm probes still hang inside node /usr/local/bin/pnpm before spawning children, even with CI=true COREPACK_ENABLE_PROJECT_SPEC=0. Keep issue open.

title: Integrate roadmap completion review into BDD/TDD backlog
description: Validate current roadmap completion against review findings and implemented code, summarize finished-product capability gaps, update the implementation roadmap, and create Beads backlog items with BDD/TDD acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap document records current completion status; Beads contains executable BDD/TDD backlog for remaining product capabilities; integration log records dispositions.
notes: Review inputs: docs/reviews/overseer-review/review_panel_report.md, docs/multi-phase-implementation-strategy.md, docs/feature-gap-implementation-plan.md, current src/tests scan. Current code shows several R2 remediations implemented, while CLI parity, service/API surface, http2 semantics, timezone parsing, and pnpm-wrapper validation remain unfinished.
close_reason: Roadmap completion reviewed, finished-product capability gaps summarized in docs/multi-phase-implementation-strategy.md, and BDD/TDD child backlog created in Beads.

Acceptance: pnpm run quality:check completes non-interactively or the root cause is documented with a stable workaround in repo docs.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run quality:check completes non-interactively, or documented workaround is accepted and linked from Phase 0 notes.
close_reason: Validated: pnpm run quality:check completes non-interactively.

title: BDD/TDD: add service auth TLS and restart recovery
description: Capability: production-safe service operation. BDD: Given auth token and TLS configuration, when clients call service endpoints, then unauthorized requests are rejected and authorized HTTPS requests succeed; given a service restart, then accepted evaluation jobs, artifacts, and final states recover from durable storage. TDD: add failing tests for auth required/optional modes, TLS config validation, persisted job recovery, corrupted state handling, and graceful shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Auth and TLS are configurable and tested; evaluation state and artifacts survive process restart; recovery errors are observable and bounded.

title: BDD/TDD: implement artifacts and recon service endpoints
description: Capability: retrievable audit outputs and recon workflows. BDD: Given a completed evaluation, when GET /evaluations/{id}/artifacts is called, then JSON/HTML/PDF/LLM/GEO artifacts are listed and retrievable; given POST /recon, then recon output is returned without full evaluation side effects. TDD: add failing tests for artifact manifest shape, missing artifact errors, path traversal rejection, recon request validation, and recon/evaluation isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact and recon endpoints pass contract tests; artifacts cannot escape the configured output root; recon can run independently of evaluation jobs.

title: BDD/TDD: implement evaluation job lifecycle API
description: Capability: asynchronous audit execution. BDD: Given POST /evaluations with a valid target and options, when the service accepts the request, then it returns a job id; GET /evaluations/{id} returns queued/running/succeeded/failed state; GET /evaluations/{id}/result returns the final report. TDD: add failing contract tests for submission, polling, cancellation/error states, invalid inputs, and concurrent job isolation before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation jobs have durable ids and deterministic states; invalid requests return stable errors; concurrent jobs do not corrupt each other.

title: BDD/TDD: implement serve command with health and capabilities contracts
description: Capability: service-mode product entrypoint. BDD: Given a configured local or remote service mode, when the user runs the serve command, then GET /health reports readiness and GET /capabilities returns engines, evaluators, formats, persistence, recon, and security features. TDD: add failing HTTP contract tests for startup, shutdown, health, capabilities schema, invalid config, and port collision before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: serve command starts non-interactively; /health and /capabilities pass contract tests; service exits cleanly and reports configuration errors.

title: BDD/TDD: define persist toggle and HTTP2 CLI semantics
description: Capability: explicit runtime semantics. BDD: Given --persist or --no-persist, when an audit runs, then ontology/audit state is either durably recorded or skipped as requested; given --http2, when HTTP transport is selected, then the CLI either uses HTTP/2 transport or fails fast if unsupported. TDD: add failing config and CLI tests for persist defaults, no-persist behavior, http2 enablement, and unsupported transport errors before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Persist behavior is explicit and tested; reserved --http2 is implemented or removed with documented compatibility; no silent ignored flag remains.

title: BDD/TDD: implement recon and recon-auto CLI modes
description: Capability: pre-audit reconnaissance. BDD: Given a target URL, when --recon is selected, then the CLI emits protection, platform, header, and risk signals without running a full audit; when --recon-auto is selected, then recon findings tune engine choice and audit options before evaluation. TDD: add failing tests for recon-only output, recon-auto option derivation, Cloudflare/protection fixtures, and audit integration handoff.
acceptance_criteria: --recon and --recon-auto are executable, documented, and covered by contract/unit tests; recon-auto decisions are visible in report metadata.

title: BDD/TDD: implement semantic search CLI parity
description: Capability: searchable audit and ontology knowledge. BDD: Given persisted audit/ontology data, when the user runs --search-semantic with a query, then matching findings, pages, and ontology symbols are returned with scores and stable output formatting. TDD: add failing CLI and ontology-store tests for query parsing, empty-index behavior, ranked results, and JSON/LLM output compatibility before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: --search-semantic works against persisted data; tests cover ranked hits, no-hit output, invalid query handling, and backward-compatible evaluate mode.

title: BDD/TDD: implement watch mode CLI parity
description: Capability: continuous audit execution. BDD: Given a target and watch-enabled source paths, when a file change or interval trigger occurs, then the CLI reruns the audit, refreshes artifacts, and exits cleanly on SIGINT/SIGTERM. TDD: add failing CLI contract tests for --watch trigger behavior and teardown before implementation; add process-lifecycle test proving BrowserPool and cache resources close after a watched run.
acceptance_criteria: --watch is documented and executable; contract tests cover trigger, artifact refresh, and clean shutdown; existing evaluate behavior remains backward compatible.

Acceptance: desktop package metadata reflects bump, lockfile state is coherent, and quality gate remains green or documented with precise blocker.
acceptance_criteria: Electron bump imported; dependency metadata remains coherent; validation is rerun and recorded.
notes: Importing Electron bump from Dependabot branch without merging stale npm/package-lock history.

title: BDD/TDD: align docs with executable CLI and service behavior
description: Capability: finished-product user guidance. BDD: Given the README, CLI guide, release process, and examples, when a user follows documented commands, then each command exists and produces described outputs. TDD: add docs-command smoke tests for CLI examples, service examples, env configuration, artifact paths, and release checklist commands before final doc updates.
acceptance_criteria: Docs only describe implemented behavior; command examples are smoke-tested; release checklist includes quality, coverage, pack dry-run, audit, and artifact hygiene gates.

title: BDD/TDD: replace dynamic eval import wrappers
description: Capability: maintainable dependency loading. BDD: Given optional runtime dependencies such as playwright-core, when modules load, then standard dynamic import paths work without eval-style Function wrappers and produce actionable missing-dependency errors. TDD: add failing tests that scan built/source modules for new Function import wrappers and verify missing dependency messaging before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: No dynamic eval import wrappers remain in source; optional dependency behavior stays clear and tested; bundler/static-analysis compatibility improves.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD on feature/bdd-tdd-product-backlog: timezone-aware PageSpeed parsing fixtures now pass; dynamic eval import wrappers replaced and guarded by tsconfig compatibility test.

title: BDD/TDD: support timezone-aware PageSpeed date metrics
description: Capability: international audit correctness. BDD: Given PageSpeed or GEO/AEO metric payloads containing timezone-aware or localized date strings, when summaries are parsed, then scores and freshness calculations are stable across timezones. TDD: add failing schema/parser tests with UTC offsets, localized strings, missing timezone data, and daylight-saving boundary fixtures before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Timezone-aware fixtures parse deterministically; invalid localized dates fail or degrade with explicit diagnostics; existing PageSpeed summary tests still pass.
notes: TDD RED: added PageSpeed localized metric/timezone fixtures in tests/pagespeed-service.test.js; they failed because lcpMs/parseErrors/fetchedAt were undefined. GREEN: added fallback localized displayValue parsing, UTC fetchTime normalization, parseErrors, schema fields; verified non-incremental build plus node --test tests/pagespeed-service.test.js tests/db-schemas.test.js.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD on feature/bdd-tdd-product-backlog: timezone-aware PageSpeed parsing fixtures now pass; dynamic eval import wrappers replaced and guarded by tsconfig compatibility test.
